answer: Score agents with a peer-prediction rule, the Bayesian truth serum: pay only for the surprising, mutually-informative signal a report adds against the consensus, never for mere agreement. A swarm of forged duplicates that just echoes the flock earns nothing, since copied reports carry zero fresh information. Like a raven that only mimics others, a cloned identity logs no new sightings on the collective voyage; an attacker spinning up a thousand parrots cannot forge extra reward, because influence here demands genuinely independent evidence no copy can manufacture.
